title: Text: PHI Steve Jongewaard ↔ Anthony Fenech

searchText: anthony, good hearing from you. have a safe season. i was let go by the phillies in september and did not hook up with another club. sign of the times with my age, experience and salary. i’m afraid it’s going to be a veteran scout blood bath when most contacts end october 31st. travel safe. steve phi steve jongewaard
